name: ima-knowledge-kit
description: Bring Tencent ima (ima.copilot) notes and knowledge bases into QwenWork via the official ima OpenAPI. This plugin does NOT bundle ima's code — it installs the official ima-skill on demand and guides first-run credential setup.
descriptionEn: Bring Tencent ima (ima.copilot) notes and knowledge bases into QwenWork via the official ima OpenAPI. This plugin does NOT bundle ima's code — it installs the official ima-skill on demand and guides first-run credential setup.
descriptionZh: 基于 ima 官方 OpenAPI，把腾讯 ima（ima.copilot）的笔记与知识库接入千问办公。本插件不内置腾讯官方代码，而是按需从官方 zip 安装 ima-skill，并引导首次凭证配置。
